drug_identity.off_label_note: Dietary supplement (not an FDA-approved drug). All dosages are anecdotal/extra-label.

metabolism_and_clearance.extra_information: Both glucosamine HCl and sulfate can be absorbed in the gut, but bioavailability may be very low and highly variable. Chondrocytes can use exogenously administered glucosamine.

organ_burden_logic.note: Based on reported adverse effects and lack of significant organ toxicity.

blood.evidence: Changes in coagulation parameters could occur at overdoses. High doses may enhance the effects of anticoagulants. In vitro, does not affect canine platelet aggregation.
Changes in coagulation parameters could occur at high doses.

timing_profile.evidence: Onset of any clinical efficacy may require 2 to 6 weeks of treatment.

drug_interactions.evidence: A high dose of chondroitin sulfate and/or glucosamine potentially could enhance the effects of drugs that affect coagulation.
Glucosamine may decrease the efficacy of hypoglycemic agents.
Glucosamine may induce resistance by reducing inhibition of topoisomerase II.

dosage_list.context: Adjunctive treatment of chronic pain conditions
dosage_list.duration_note: After 4 to 6 weeks, if a positive response is seen, dosage may be halved or given every other day.

dosage_list.context: Adjunctive treatment of chronic pain conditions
dosage_list.duration_note: After 4 to 6 weeks, if a positive response is seen, dosage may be halved or given every other day.

effects_and_mechanisms.common_mechanism: Glucosamine provides glycosaminoglycan building blocks to strengthen cartilage, regulates synthesis of collagen/proteoglycans, and has mild anti-inflammatory effects. Chondroitin sulfate inhibits destructive enzymes in joint fluid/cartilage and stimulates GAG/proteoglycan production.

species_notes.dog: Can be administered long-term, even to dogs with comorbidities, unlike NSAIDs. Well tolerated.
species_notes.cat: Glucosamine and chondroitin improved mobility and lameness scores in cats with osteoarthritis.

dog.evidence: Well tolerated. Caution in patients on a potassium-restricted diet or with bronchoconstrictive conditions.

cat.evidence: Well tolerated. Caution in patients on a potassium-restricted diet or with bronchoconstrictive conditions.

storage_and_forms.storage: Chondroitin sulfate is extremely hygroscopic. Store in tight containers at room temperature. Avoid direct sunlight and keep away from moisture.

section_1_2_10.highlights: Dietary supplement (not an FDA-approved drug) that may be useful as an adjunctive treatment for osteoarthritis or other painful conditions. Well tolerated, but efficacy is uncertain. Large variation in commercially available products.
section_1_2_10.indications: Adjunctive treatment for osteoarthritis or other painful conditions. N-acetyl-d-glucosamine has been tested in cats with FLUTD.
section_1_2_10.client_info: May take 2 to 6 weeks (or longer) of treatment to see if this supplement is helping. Mild gastrointestinal upset (eg, decreased appetite) has been reported. May be given with or without food.
